score_scale: Each event carries score in [-1, 1]: +1 strongly bullish flow/filing, -1 strongly bearish. The aggregator averages events per symbol and renormalises weights over whatever coverage exists.

market_flow.source: Goldman Sachs India strategy note (via Financial Express, 17 Nov 2026); CNBC TV18 FII flows, 18 Nov 2026; SEBI filings via DocStoX, 19 Nov 2026
